name: @ai-idioms/core
description: Plain values and functions for talking to a model: parts, messages, one provider port, and the pieces of a tool loop.
//: Inside this workspace the package is run as source, through the `@ai-idioms/source` condition, so nothing here needs a build. What is published is `dist/`, built by `prepack`.

scripts.build: node --eval "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
